_source: Thermal runs of 2026-11-05 on Logan's PC (run_oz.py, then analyze_oz.py). The oz_metrics.json they wrote stayed on the PC; these values are transcribed from the study note of 2026-11-05. 25 C ambient, d44 policy, TH101/TH104 at out29. dis100 = 100 W out of USB1 (port 1), dis100u2 = 100 W out of USB2 (port 2). Burst minutes have 20 s steps. The note gives energy in 40 min and hottest can as one value per weight without naming the port, so they are kept apart here.
